entities.summary: Walter Bryce Gallie was a Scottish social theorist, political theorist, and philosopher. In 1940 he married Welsh-speaking novelist Menna Humphreys, with whom he had a son and a daughter. He made two notable contributions to philosophy. In 1952 he had his book Peirce and pragmatism published, which introduced the work of Charles Sanders Peirce to an international readership.
